description: Compare programmes side by side. Pass a + b (two programme ids) for the canonical versioned comparison artefact from the Mirabello Investment Migration Index: rank, composite, the dimension scores, per-dimension deltas, per-metric leads (a|b|tie) and the human compare page URL where one exists. Or pass ids (2-4) for the classic multi-column comparison of cost, processing, mobility, family inclusion, tax, path to citizenship. Use this, not several get_programme calls, whenever the user wants two or more programmes compared; ids or names ("Portugal golden visa") both work.

a.description: programme id (use with b) for the canonical two-programme artefact

ids.description: 2-4 programme ids for the classic comparison

name: compare_programmes

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Compare Programmes
